meta.name: GS009 UGC Google Review Comments - September 2026
meta.description: Natural-language modular review choices aligned with the UGC Google Review Guideline UTD September 2026.
meta.usage_note: Customer must choose only a comment that truthfully matches their own experience and submit it using their own account and device.
meta.same_user_monthly_rule: Repeated Google Reviews from the same user in the same month count as one review only.
meta.generation_structure: Every category combines 14 natural leads, 20 compliant cores and 14 natural closings. The browser avoids comments previously displayed on the same device.
